sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Surendra Singh-I,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Standing Counsel for the State-respondents.

2. The instant petition has been filed praying for a writ of mandamus commanding the respondents to allow the petitioner to build home on his land i.e. Arazi No. 441 (?) in Mauja Devghat, Tehsil Sadar, District- Prayagraj and pay compensation at 4 times the current circle rate.
3. It is not disputed that the land of the petitioner was acquired under the provisions of Land Acquisition Act, 1894 (hereinafter referred to as the 'Act').
The notification u/s 4 of the Act was issued on 22.03.2013 as would appear from the notification filed along with the writ petition.

sentences.text: However, the petitioner has not disclosed the date of publication of notification u/s 6 of the Act nor whether any award has been made or not.

5. Since material particulars necessary for deciding the issue sought to be raised are lacking, the instant writ petition is dismissed with liberty to file a better writ petition or avail such other remedy as may be advised.
